senses.gloss:
वैद वैद, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. विद), relating to
or connected with a wise man, learned, knowing;
(अस्), m. a wise man; (ई), f. the wife of a wise
man, (Pāṇ. IV. 1, 73.)

वैदग्ध वैदग्ध, अम्, n. (fr. वि-दग्ध),
cleverness, dexterity, skill, intelligence, acuteness,
sharpness, craft, cunning.
वैदग्धी, f. artifice, craft, trick (= भङ्गि).

वैदथिन वैदथिन, अस्, m. (fr. विदथिन्),
Ved. a patronymic of Ṛjiśvan.

वैददश्वि वैददश्वि, इस्, m. a patronymic,
the son of Vidad-aśva, Ṛg-veda V. 61, 10.

वैदर्भ वैदर्भ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-दर्भ or
fr. दृभ formed fr. rt. 1. दृभ् with वि), coming
from the country Vidarbha, produced in Vidarbha;
(अस्), m. the sovereign of Vidarbha (father of Dama-
yantī and father-in-law of Nala); a gum-boil; (ई),
f. the law of the country Vidarbha (by which first
cousins were allowed to intermarry); epithet of the
wife of Agastya; of Damayantī (wife of Nala); of
Rukmiṇī (one of Kṛṣṇa's wives); a particular style
[]
of composition (see रीति); (अम्), n. crafty or indirect
speech.
—वैदर्भ-रीति, इस्, f. the Vidarbha style
of composition (see रीति).
—वैदर्भी-जननी, f.
the mother of Damayantī.

वैदर्भक, अस्, इका, अम्, coming from Vidar-
bha, a native of Vidarbha.

वैदल वैदल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-दल), made
of wicker or cane, wicker or basket-work; (अस्), m.
a flat unleavened cake (made of flour &c. with
cumin or coriander seeds and fried in ghee); any
leguminous vegetable or grain (as peas, beans, &c.);
(अम्), n. the shallow cup or platter belonging to a
religious mendicant (made of clay and sometimes
of metal or wood or wicker); any seat or vessel of
basket or wicker-work.
वैदारव वैदारव, वैदार्व. See श्वैत.

वैदिक वैदिक, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. वेद),
derived from or conformable to the Vedas, relating
to the Vedas, Vedic, prescribed by Vedic ritual,
knowing the Vedas, scriptural, sacred; (अस्), m. a
Brāhman versed in the Vedas.
—वैदिक-कर्मन्,
अ, n. an action enjoined by the Vedas.
—वैदिक-
त्व, अम्, n. conformity to the Vedas, the being
founded on or derived from the Vedas, sacredness.
—वैदिक-पाश, अस्, m. a bad Veda-knower, one
imperfectly versed in the Veda, (Pāṇ. V. 3, 47.)

वैदिश वैदिश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. विदिशा), of or
belonging to the city of Vidiśā, near Vidiśā.
—वै-
दिश-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
वैदिश्य, अम्, n. a city not far from Vidiśā.

वैदुष्य वैदुष्य, अम्, n. (fr. विद्वस्), wisdom,
learning, science, sapience.
वैदुषी, f. = वैदुष्य.

वैदूर्य वैदूर्य, अस्, ई, or री, अम् (fr. वि-दूर),
brought from Vidūra; (अम्), n. a gem of a dark
colour, lapis lazuli or a kind of turkois; N. of a
mountain; of a mythical mountain.
—वैदूर्य-म-
य, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consisting of lapis lazuli.
वैदूर्य = वैदूर्य, q. v.

वैदेशिक वैदेशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-देश),
belonging to another country, foreign, strange, a
foreigner.

वैदेश्य, अम्, n. the state of belonging to a
foreign country, foreignness.

वैदेह वैदेह, अस्, m. (fr. वि-देह), the king
of Videha (father of Sītā); a dweller in Videha;
a trader by caste; the son of a Vaiśya by a Brāhman
woman (Manu X. 11); an attendant on the women's
apartments; (आस्), m. pl. people of Videha; people
of mixed castes; (ई), f. Sītā (daughter of Janaka);
the wife of a merchant, woman of the Vaideha
caste; a sort of pigment (= रोचना); long pepper;
a cow.
—वैदेहि-बन्धु, उस्, m. (for वैदेही-ब्˚
by Pāṇ. VI. 3, 63), ‘husband of the lady of Videha,’ an
epithet of Rāma-candra, (Raghu-vaṃśa XIV. 33.)

वैदेहक, अस्, m. a merchant or trader by caste;
a man of a mixed caste (the offspring of a Vaiśya
father and Brāhman mother whose business is attend-
ance in the women's apartments).
वैदेहिक, अस्, m. a merchant (= वैदेहक).

वैद्य वैद्य, अस्, -दी, अम् (fr. वेद), relating
or belonging to the Vedas, conformable to the Vedas,
Vedic; medical, medicinal, practising or relating to
medicine [cf. आयुर्-वेद]; (अस्), m. a learned man,
doctor, Paṇḍit, a follower of the Vedas or one well
versed in them; a medical man, doctor, physician;
a man of the medical caste (enumerated among the
mixed classes and originally the offspring of a Brāh-
man by a Vaiśya woman; he is also called Amba-
ṣṭha, Manu X. 8); a man of another and lower
mixed caste (said to be the descendant of a Śūdra
father and Vaiśya mother; cf. चण्डाल, व्रात्य);
the tree Justicia Ganderussa; (आ), f. a particular
drug or medicinal substance (= काकोली).
—वैद्य-
क्रिया, f. the business of a physician.
—वैद्य-
नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord of physicians,’ epithet of Śiva;
of Dhanvantari; of a poet; of a country.
—वैद्य-
[]
बन्धु, उस्, m. the tree Cassia Fistula (= आरग्-
बध).
—वैद्य-भूषण, ‘ornament of phy-
sicians,’ N. of a work by Rāmānanda-svāmin.
—वैद्य-मातृ, ता, f. the mother of a physician;
the tree Justicia Ganderussa (= 1. वासक).
—वैद्य-
वल्लभ, अस्, m. ‘favourite with physicians,’ N. of a
medical work on the treatment of fever by Śārṅgha-
dhara.
—वैद्य-सिंही, f. the plant Justicia Gande-
russa (= 1. वासक).

वैद्यक, अस्, ई, अम्, medical, relating to medi-
cine; (अस्), m. a doctor, physician, medical man;
(अम्), n. the science of medicine, the Āyur-veda,
q. v.
—वैद्यक-शास्त्र, अम्, n. the science of medi-
cine.
—वैद्यक-सर्व-स्व, अम्, n., N. of a work
by Nakula.

वैद्याधर वैद्याधर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. विद्या-
धर), belonging to the Vidyā-dharas.

वैद्याधर वैद्याधर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. विद्युत्),
coming or proceeding from lightning, belonging to
or connected with lightning, electric, electrical,
(वैद्युतः कृशानुः, the fire of lightning.)

वैद्रुम, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-द्रुम), made of
coral.
